# Data catalog

**Generated by `intus-gen catalog` — do not edit by hand.**

Every column generated by `intus_gen` carries a sensitivity tier, assigned at
generation time and declared beside the schema it describes. The governance
phase enforces these tiers; this document is the statement of what it must
enforce.

## Tiers

| Tier | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `public` | No restriction; safe outside the company. |
| `internal` | Any employee may read. |
| `confidential` | Restricted to a business function by row-level security. |
| `restricted` | Column-masked even for holders of the surrounding rows. |

### ai_usage_event

Per-request LLM usage and cost by employee, model, and feature.

Steward: **Information Technology**. Primary key: `event_id`.

| Column | Tier | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `event_id` | `internal` | Surrogate key for the request. |
| `event_ts` | `internal` | When the request was made. |
| `employee_id` | `restricted` | Requesting employee — individual activity. |
| `department_code` | `internal` | Department the cost allocates to. |
| `region` | `internal` | Employee's region, for regional cost reporting. |
| `model` | `internal` | Model invoked. |
| `feature` | `internal` | Internal product surface the request came from. |
| `prompt_tokens` | `confidential` | Input tokens billed. |
| `completion_tokens` | `confidential` | Output tokens billed. |
| `cost_usd` | `confidential` | Computed cost of the request. |
| `latency_ms` | `internal` | End-to-end request latency. |
| `flagged_by_policy` | `restricted` | Whether a usage policy rule fired. |
